podcast.body: Devo's cover of The Rolling Stones' "Satisfaction" is presented as a prime example of their nerdy aesthetic and experimental approach, featuring their distinctive electronic sound. "As for something to play, this cover of the Rolling Stone Satisfaction from 1977 is pretty much as nerdy as it gets."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Devo covered The Rolling Stones' "Satisfaction" on their debut album. The cover was considered "weird" when it was released because it was highly unconventional to alter a Rolling Stones song in such a way. "Divo, and their cover of the Stone Satisfaction, it's really hard to explain how weird that cover was when it came out."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: The Rolling Stones Cover
podcast.body: Devo's cover of The Rolling Stones' classic "Satisfaction" appeared on their 1978 debut album, and its unexpected interpretation challenged listeners' perceptions of what new music, specifically New Wave, could sound like. "What could they do to a classic like satisfaction by the stones? This was not what I expected."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Post-Punk Explosion Part 1: New Wave
